resources.string: Enrollment JSON copied. pux tries to clear it after about a minute while the app stays focused.
Inbox address copied. Other apps can still read the clipboard; pux clears sensitive copies when possible while focused.
Code copied. pux tries to clear it after about a minute while this screen is focused.
Relay deletion did not finish because the server could not be reached. Use the menu to retry or forget locally.
Relay deletion may still be in progress on the server. Use the menu to retry or forget locally.
Device removal may still be in progress on the server. Use the menu to retry or forget locally.
Local cleanup did not finish. Codes stay paused until you retry forgetting this device.
Resolve the previous installation recovery prompt before setting up a relay. Try migrating again or discard the old encrypted data.
Finish clearing this device before creating or importing a relay. Open Home and tap Retry forget.
Create a new encrypted OTP relay, or add this device to an existing one.
Keys are generated on this phone. The private key leaves it only if you add another device.
Codes sent to your inbox address reach this device only as notifications. Without them, pux can\'t show you a code.
Allow notifications when asked, so you never miss a code.
This enrollment uses the pux server
Only continue if you recognise this server.
This clears all pux data on this device, including any saved relay keys, and restarts the app at enrollment. This cannot be undone.
Hardware-backed secure storage could not be initialized (%1$s). pux cannot store private keys in unencrypted storage.
The old relay on the server will keep running. You will need to enroll again from another device or paste an enrollment JSON to use pux on this phone.

Data from an earlier installation could not be decrypted: %1$s.\n\nYour previous encrypted data was kept on this device. Choose whether to retry migration or discard that data before creating a new relay or importing a different enrollment.
This contains your private key and relay ID. Anyone who has it can read your OTP codes. Paste it only into your own desktop app, then clear your clipboard.
This device stops receiving codes and its keys are deleted from it. Other devices on this relay keep working. To use pux here again you will need to create or import a relay.
This deletes the relay from the server. Every device on it stops receiving codes, the inbox address stops working and pending codes are discarded. This cannot be undone.
The server could not be reached or refused: %1$s\n\n%2$s
Could not save that setting. Try again.
Preferences copied from the previous install still need cleanup. Tap Try again to finish removing old encrypted data.
Local cleanup was interrupted before enrollment was wiped.
Retry to finish forgetting this device on the phone.
Enrollment was removed on this phone but legacy cleanup did not finish.
Retry to finish clearing old data before setting up again.
The saved removal request could not be recognized.
The server could not be reached, so the relay may still exist on the server. Delivery has resumed. Retry from the menu or forget locally.
The previous removal may have reached the server. Retry from the menu or forget locally.
If you forget locally, the relay keeps running on the server and your other devices keep receiving codes.
If you forget locally, the server may keep this registration until you delete the relay or reinstall the app.
